ded. The root cause is clear and fixable:
RCA (why your watcher “skips forever”)
Your is_delta() is matching against the full path (/sdcard/Download/...) but two of its patterns are not path-safe:

MB__*.mips.json does not match /sdcard/Download/MB__...mips.json (because it doesn’t start with MB__)

*"__DELTA__"*.json does not match MB__03_DELTA__... (because that filename contains _DELTA__, not __DELTA__)

So even valid deltas get skipped.
